uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

5475-5921-5970-8296.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Forensic Researcher.
Activate one of the Forensic Researcher tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Forensic Researcher token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

222-527-1251-8249.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-1251-8249.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Defiant Salvager twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

574-1453-4694-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
574-1453-4694-7306.description:
Activate Vish Kal by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Arwen.
Resolve Vish Kal's ability, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on them equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Repeat from step 1.
574-1453-4694-7306.notes: Once Vish Kal has infinite +1/+1 counters, you may activate its last ability any number of times to reduce the toughnesses of any number of creatures to 0.

443-1829-4279--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
443-1829-4279--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Vindictive Vampire, Magus of the Bridge and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Vindictive Vampire trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Resolve the Magus of the Bridge ability, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Vindictive Vampire triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and dealing 1 damage to each opponent 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

3564-4275-5329-8095.easyPrerequisites: You control another untapped nontoken Merfolk.
3564-4275-5329-8095.description:
Activate Kumena's first ability by tapping another nontoken Merfolk you control.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Kumena ability.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the Merfolk token.
When the Merfolk dies, Faces of the Past triggers, untapping all Merfolk.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.
3564-4275-5329-8095.notes: You can tap as many nontoken Merfolk as able each iteration by repeating steps 1 through 3 for each Merfolk. They will all be untapped by Faces of the Past.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

2267-4247-5058.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing the creature that has Screams from Within attached.
When the creature dies, Screams from Within triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.
Tormod triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

2829-5777-7810.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
2829-5777-7810.description:
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing a Food.
Camellia triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token and a Food artifact token.
Resolve the Arcbound Ravager ability
Repeat.

1636-5627-7889.easyPrerequisites: Wight of the Reliquary does not have summoning sickness.
1636-5627-7889.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1636-5627-7889.description:
Activate Wight of the Reliquary by tapping it and sacrificing another creature, causing you to search your library for a land card and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield, Dancing from Dark to Dawn triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

1253-4644-7791.description:
Activate Gyre Engineer by tapping it, adding {G}{U}
Activate Tidewater Minion by tapping it, targeting Gyre Engineer.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Tidewater Minion's ability, targeting Tidewater Minion.
Resolve both Tidewater Minion abilities, untapping it and Gyre Engineer.
Repeat.

2585-3053-3918.notablePrerequisites: You control a land of each basic land type.
2585-3053-3918.description:
Activate Trazyn using Prismatic Geoscope's ability by tapping it, adding five mana of any color.
Activate Trazyn using Grim Monolith's ability by paying {4}, untapping Trazyn.
Repeat.
2585-3053-3918.notes: Once you have extra mana, Grim Monolith's ability can be used instead to add mana.

1170-3200-5006.easyPrerequisites: You have not cast a spell using Lurrus this turn.
1170-3200-5006.description:
Cast Urza's Bauble from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Lurrus.
Activate Urza's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

1621-4605-7339.description:
Cast Go Ninja Go by paying its mana cost, blinking Wispweaver Angel.
Wispweaver Angel and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Wispweaver Angel trigger, blinking another permanent you control.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Wispweaver Angel that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Wispweaver Angel token enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking the nontoken Wispweaver Angel.
Repeat from step 2.

360-2308-4050-4871.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain any amount of life.
360-2308-4050-4871.description:
Gain any amount of life.
Trudge Garden triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a 4/4 Fungus Beast creature token.
When the Fungus Beast enters, Soul Warden triggers.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Fungus Beast, adding {1}.
When the Fungus Beast dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Holding priority, activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Resolve the Soul Warden trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

618-3908--112.notablePrerequisites: Spark Double is a copy of Kiki-Jiki.
618-3908--112.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Spark Double that has haste. Choose to have Spark Double enter as a copy of Kiki-Jiki.
Put the oldest Kiki-Jiki into the graveyard due to the legend rule.
Repeat step 1 using the Spark Double token instead.
Activate Spark Double by tapping it, creating a token copy of itself with haste that will be sacrificed at the next end step.
The Spark Double token enters the battlefield as a nonlegendary copy of Kiki-Jiki with an additional +1/+1 counter.
Activate the Spark Double token by tapping it, creating a token copy of itself with haste, exile that token at the end of turn.
Repeat from step 2.
618-3908--112.notes: The chosen anthem effect must increase Spark Double's toughness.

57-1753-4235-4846.notablePrerequisites: You control any number of permanents that enter untapped and that can collectively tap to produce at least {4}{R}.
57-1753-4235-4846.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {4}{R}.
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers, causing you to pay {2} to copy Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

436-3668-5220.description:
Cast Flesh Duplicate by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Ao.
Put Flesh Duplicate into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Flesh Duplicate dies, it and Mortuary trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Flesh Duplicate from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Flesh Duplicate trigger, causing you to look at the top seven cards of your library and put Flesh Duplicate onto the battlefield as a copy of Ao.
Repeat from step 2.

104-3490-5231-6823.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-3490-5231-6823.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Aunt May triggers, causing you to gain life.
Cleric Class triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the Cleric Class trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

4699-4771-5220-6900.description:
Activate Myr Scrapling by sacrificing it.
When Myr Scrapling dies, Mortuary and Overgrowth Elemental trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Myr Scrapling from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Overgrowth Elemental trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Myr Scrapling ability.
Cast Myr Scrapling from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

2854-4574-4708-5741.easyPrerequisites: Showdown of the Skalds' second or third chapter ability has triggered this turn.
2854-4574-4708-5741.description:
Cast Dark Sphere either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {0}
Showdown of the Skalds triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Reclaimer.
Activate Dark Sphere by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Dark Sphere from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

2292-3234-3293-5412.easyPrerequisites: You control a Plains or have a Plains in your graveyard.
2292-3234-3293-5412.description:
Activate Coastal Hornclaw by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 1 until you control no lands.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing World Shaper.
When World Shaper dies, it triggers, return all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning World Shaper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all remaining Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat
2292-3234-3293-5412.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard and library to the battlefield if you control there are two or more Plains between your graveyard, library and battlefield. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

2173-3944-4063-5220.description:
Activate Blood Pet by sacrificing it.
When Blood Pet dies, Mortuary and Fleshtaker trigger.
Resolve the Fleshtaker trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and scry 1.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Blood Pet from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Blood Pet from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

1496-4593-4659-6291.description:
Activate Mite Overseer by paying {3}{W/P}, creating a 1/1 Thopter and a 1/1 Phyrexian Mite artifact creature token.
When the Phyrexian Mite and Thopter enter, Verdant Sun's Avatar triggers twice, causing you to gain 2 life
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing the Phyrexian Mite and Thopter, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.
1496-4593-4659-6291.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the Phyrexian Mite and/or Thopter

1274-3188-3197.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1274-3188-3197.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Social Climber triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

435-4056-4679--82.description:
Activate the mana-producing creature by tapping it, adding at least {2}.
Activate Yenna by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Second Wind attached to the mana-producing creature, then untapping Yenna and causing you to scry 2.
Activate the Second Wind token's second ability by tapping it, untapping the mana-producing creature.
Activate Auratog by sacrificing the Second Wind token.
Repeat.
435-4056-4679--82.notes: If the creature being tapped for mana can add {3} or more, this combo will net infinite mana of those color(s) and type(s).

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

3259-5223-6664.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You control five or more Towns.
3259-5223-6664.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, The Wandering Minstrel triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

1479-4862-5700-5701-6664.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-4862-5700-5701-6664.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Omnath trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Omnath trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield untapped as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Omnath triggers.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Omnath trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Omnath triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1270-1322-3228-5477.description:
Activate Mobilization by paying {2}{W}, creating three 1/1 Soldier creature tokens.
Activate the Soldiers by tapping them, adding {2}{W}.
Repeat.

957-1618-6496--97.easyPrerequisites: You have a storm count of 1 if the self-suspending card is not in your hand, or a storm count of 0 otherwise.
957-1618-6496--97.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Time Stretch and the self-suspending card, if needed, during the first turn.
957-1618-6496--97.description:
Cast the self-suspending card by paying its mana cost if its in your hand, or any other spell otherwise if you have not cast a spell this turn.
Cast Time Stretch by paying its mana cost.
Taigam triggers, copying Time Stretch and then exiling it with four time counters on it and giving it suspend.
Resolve the copy of Time Stretch, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Move to your first extra turn. At the beginning of that turn's upkeep, Time Stretch and the self-suspending card's suspend abilities trigger, removing a time counter from each of them.
Move to your second extra turn. At the beginning of that turn's upkeep, Time Stretch and the self-suspending card's suspend abilities trigger, removing a time counter from each of them.
Activate The Tenth Doctor by paying {7}, removing three time counters from Time Stretch and the self-suspending card, triggering their suspend abilities.
Resolve the self-suspending card's suspend trigger, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost, and eventually exile it with time counters on it.
Resolve the Time Stretch's suspend trigger, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 3.
957-1618-6496--97.notes: It is highly recommended to choose a self-suspending card that you are certain will have legal targets, if applicable, every time it is cast.

1753-2105-3204-4251.notablePrerequisites:
Mysterious Limousine does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
One of Godo or Combat Celebrant must be on the battlefield, with the other exiled by Mysterious Limousine.
1753-2105-3204-4251.description:
Declare either Godo or Combat Celebrant and Mysterious Limousine as attackers.
Mysterious Limousine and either Godo or Combat Celebrant trigger.
Resolve the Godo or Combat Celebrant trigger, untapping Mysterious Limousine and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Mysterious Limousine trigger, exiling Godo or Combat Celebrant from the battlefield, and then returning Godo or Combat Celebrant from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

203-1170-6203.manaNeeded: {3}{W} if Throne of Eldraine's chosen color is not "White"
203-1170-6203.description:
If able, activate Throne of Eldraine's first ability by tapping it, adding {W}{W}{W}{W} that can only be spent to cast white monocolored spells.
Cast Anoint with buyback by paying {3}{W}, targeting Displacer Kitten.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Throne of Eldraine. Choose "White" as it enters the battlefield.
Resolve Anoint, returning it to your hand.
Repeat.

3277-4377-6122.notablePrerequisites: {1}{U} available plus enough mana to cast Walk the Aeons and Izzet Chronarch each turn.
3277-4377-6122.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Izzet Chronarch by paying its mana cost.
When Izzet Chronarch enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Walk the Aeons from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Dour Port-Mage by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, returning Izzet Chronarch from the battlefield to your hand.
Dour Port-Mage triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

224-277-774-5923.notablePrerequisites:
Wonderscape Sage does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one mana-producing land.
224-277-774-5923.description:
Activate the mana-producing land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Wonderscape Sage by tapping it and returning the mana-producing land from the battlefield to your hand, causing you to draw a card and discard a card if the land didn't have a nonbasic land type.
Activate Patron of the Moon by paying {1}, putting the mana-producing land from your hand onto the battlefield.
When the land enters the battlefield, Tiller Engine and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Wonderscape Sage.
Resolve the Tiller Engine trigger, untapping the land.
Repeat.

3277-5232-5718.description:
Cast Clone Legion by paying {7}{U}{U}, causing you to create a token copy of Hidetsugu and Kairi and Izzet Chronarch.
Put the token Hidetsugu and Kairi into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Hidetsugu and Kairi token's first and second abilities trigger, as well as Izzet Chronarch.
Resolve the Izzet Chronarch trigger, returning Clone Legion from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the first Hidetsugu and Kairi trigger, causing you to draw three cards and then put Clone Legion and another card on top of your library, ensuring Clone Legion is on top.
Resolve the second Hidetsugu and Kairi trigger, exiling Clone Legion from the top of your library, then causing an opponent to lose 9 life and allowing you to cast Clone Legion from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Clone Legion, causing you to create a token copy of Hidetsugu and Kairi and Izzet Chronarch.
Repeat from step 2.

2178-3129-4214-4312.notablePrerequisites:
Utopia Mycon has at least three spore counters on it.
Thornbite Staff attached to Vorel of the Hull Clade.
Vorel of the Hull Clade does not have summoning sickness.
2178-3129-4214-4312.description:
Activate Vorel of the Hull Clade by paying {G}{U} and tapping it, doubling the number of counters on Utopia Mycon.
Activate Utopia Mycon's first ability by removing three spore counters from it, creating two 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Utopia Mycon's second ability twice by sacrificing the Saprolings, adding {G}{U}.
When the Saporlings die, Vorel of the Hull Clade triggers twice, untapping it.
Repeat.
If Utopia Mycon has four or more spore counters on it to begin the combo, this combo nets infinite spore counters on Utopia Mycon, which you may remove for infinite Saproling tokens and/or colored mana, or target another creature using Vorel of the Hull Clade.

141-2034-3331-5220.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional artifact, enchantment and/or token.
141-2034-3331-5220.description:
Cast Thunderous Debut by paying {6}{G}{G} and sacrificing an artifact, enchantment or token.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying {2}{U}{U}.
When Naru Meha enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Thunderous Debut.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Naru Meha, adding {C}{C}.
When Naru Meha dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Naru Meha on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the copy of Thunderous Debut, causing you to look at the top twenty cards of your library and put Naru Meha and up to one other creature card onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

4131-4639-4832.notablePrerequisites:
Ensoul Artifact attached to Basalt Monolith.
Basalt Monolith does not have summoning sickness.
4131-4639-4832.description:
Activate Unctus by paying {U/P}, causing Basalt Monolith to become a blue artifact in addition to its other types until end of turn.
Activate Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Basalt Monolith triggers, causing you to loot.
Activate Basalt Monolith's second ability by paying {C}{C}{C}, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.

2954-4067-4435.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least three cards in hand with different names.
You control an Island.
2954-4067-4435.description:
Activate an Island by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Ormos by paying {1}{U}{U} and discarding three cards with different names, causing you to draw ten cards.
Activate Mind over Matter by discading a card, untapping the Island.
Activate the Island by tapping it, adding {U}.
Repeat from step 3 two additional times.
Repeat from step 2.

1430-2781.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Mirror Image.
1430-2781.description:
Cast Mirror Image by paying its mana cost, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Felidar Guardian
When Mirror Image enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Felidar Guardian.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Mirror Image. Choose to have Mirror Image enter the battlefield as a copy of Felidar Guardian.
Repeat from step 2.
